title: Full BZK12 greedy round-and-resolve in cross-field MI (replace PATCH-39 simplified solver)
description:
**Replaces PATCH-39's simplified 3-stage solver** which produces too many spurious singularities (5788 on a 24k-face Procedural.obj; 27 on a subdivided cube vs expected 6-8). Every downstream stage (PATCH-40 IGM, PATCH-41 motorcycle T-mesh) compensates for the spurious singularities and can't recover; cube produces 0 patches end-to-end.

PATCH-39 simplified pipeline:
  1. Solve theta-only LSQ with m=0
  2. Round per-edge residuals to integer m_e
  3. Refine theta with m fixed

Full BZK12 greedy (Bommes-Zimmer-Kobbelt 2012, Practical Mixed-Integer Optimization):
  1. Relax all m_ij to real → solve LSQ over (theta, m) reals.
  2. Find the m_ij whose relaxed value is closest to an integer (most-confident).
  3. Hard-pin it to the nearest integer; add as constraint.
  4. Re-solve. Repeat until all cycle-basis m_ij are integers.

Same iterative-rounding pattern that PATCH-48 implements for the IGM stage; the difference is the variable space (cycle-basis integer rotations vs. corner UV).

The pipeline-pattern is identical so this can largely reuse PATCH-48's IterativeRounding.java structure adapted for the cross-field formulation.

Also fix the m_ij encoding: angle-based MI (Campen Eq. 4.6) needs ONE integer per spanning-tree edge of the FACE-CYCLE basis (not per interior edge). PATCH-39 currently rounds per interior edge which over-constrains the system and produces spurious singularities by per-edge rounding error accumulation.

See Campen 2014 thesis Sec 4.2 + Bommes 2009 + Bommes 2012 for the cycle-basis formulation.
definition-of-done: 1. Cube: ≤ 8 singularities (instead of 6-27); ideally 8 (Poincaré-Hopf minimum on a topological sphere). 2. Subdivided cube (n=4): same range, NOT 27. 3. Sphere icosphere: 8 singularities of index +1/4 (sum = 4χ = 8). 4. Procedural.obj: ≤ 200 singularities, sum still respects Poincaré-Hopf. 5. PATCH-41 motorcycle graph produces ≥ 1 valid 4-cycle patch on the cube. 6. All existing unit.qgp.vectorfield.* tests still pass.
testing-plan:
1. Existing FaceRosyFieldTest + SingularityFinderTest must keep passing (cube/sphere/torus/flat-plane Poincaré-Hopf checks). 2. Add singular-count tightening: cube ≤ 8, subdivided cube ≤ 12 (allowing some over-detection but not 27). 3. VerifyMotorcycleGraph on cube reports ≥ 1 patch. 4. Document algorithmic flow in FaceRosyField class JavaDoc with reference to BZK12 Sec 3.

References:
- Bommes-Zimmer-Kobbelt 2009. Mixed-integer Quadrangulation. SIGGRAPH 2009.
- Bommes-Zimmer-Kobbelt 2012. Practical Mixed-Integer Optimization for Geometry Processing. Curves and Surfaces 2012.
- Campen 2014 thesis Sec 4.2.
- Reference implementation: see PATCH-48's IterativeRounding.java for the pattern (different variable space).
